messages:
joanne_cs: Heads-up — Acme reported a sudden spike of 403s for embeddings and rerank in their nightly batch after SSO key rotation. Happens only in their batch pipeline, single-call tests sometimes succeed. :thinking_face:

mike_infra: Do we have the exact error payloads? Any correlation id or example request?

joanne_cs: Customer sent a couple of examples. Batch job curl -> 403: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch/rerank \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer svc_XXX' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"items": [...]}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","detail":"missing scopes: rerank"}
```
Single request to /v1/generate with same token returns 200. Embeddings endpoint for the same token sometimes 403 with "missing scope: embeddings".

alex_support: Weird that same token is allowed for generate but not for embeddings/rerank. Could be a scope normalization issue in the provisioner or a claim-mapping bug from SCIM/SSO.

sso-bot: svcaccount rotation executed for tenant=acme-corp svc=svc-acme-2026-07-01 by id=ops-rotator at 2026-07-05T02:03:12Z. Generated token id: svc_ABC123.

mike_infra: Can you repro locally with their token? If not, ask them to run the minimal curl and paste the response headers. Also: is their batch path using an older client or a proxy that strips scopes?

joanne_cs: I asked for headers and sample token. They provided token (redacted) and logs show errors only when batch size > 1, weird. Small single-item batch works.

eng-plat: That points at our route that handles /batch/* — we do additional auth checks there for legacy rerank compatibility. If the provisioner emitted combined scopes like "inference,embeds" but not explicit "rerank", our batch endpoint rejects it.

laura_cs: Is there a known change in SCIM mapping recently? Acme uses SSO auto-provisioning that maps OKTA groups -> service scopes via the provisioner.

alex_support: Found the provisioning audit for svc_ABC123: provisioner created the key with scopes ["inference","embeddings"] but NOT "rerank". Looks like the SCIM mapping rule that used to add rerank for group "acme-rerank" didn't fire — group claim was empty because okta sent nested arrays after recent schema change.

mike_infra: Nice find. So generate worked because "inference" satisfies /generate, embeddings sometimes allowed because we treat "embeddings" alias permissively for single-item requests, but batch/rerank needs explicit "rerank" scope.

eng-plat: Proposed fix: update provisioner to accept nested group claims and re-run provisioning for affected svcaccounts. Quick mitigation: re-provision svc_ABC123 with explicit scopes including rerank, or temporarily add a fallback in the batch auth check to accept "inference" for rerank until we patch.

alex_support: I ran the repro locally by calling the provisioner with the same claim payload (copied from Okta). Confirmed it produced scopes missing rerank. After adjusting mapping to handle arrays, re-provision command we used: 
```
rb-provision --svc-id svc_ABC123 --tenant acme-corp --scopes "inference,embeddings,rerank"
```
Token now returns 200 for batch rerank and embeddings CI tests pass.

joanne_cs: Customer wants ETA on permanent fix and whether rotating keys will break things.

eng-plat: We'll roll a small patch to the provisioner SCIM parser to flatten nested group claims and include regression tests. ETA: patch + deploy to staging in 24h, prod rollout 48-72h after testing. Meanwhile, re-provisioning fixes existing keys.

mike_infra: Action items:
- alex_support to re-provision affected svc accounts (list requested from customer) -> today
- eng-plat to open PR for claim parsing + unit tests -> in 4h
- ops to coordinate prod deploy -> after review
- joanne_cs to send customer-facing note explaining cause and workaround -> now

joanne_cs: Draft note for customer: "We traced the issue to a recent SSO claim change that caused our provisioner to miss adding the 'rerank' scope on a subset of rotated service keys. Re-provisioning the affected keys adds the missing scope and restores batch rerank/embeddings. We're deploying a patch to avoid this in future. If you'd like, we can re-run rotations on your behalf on a maintenance window." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

laura_cs: message looks good. Add: "no data was exposed; this is an auth scoping issue only."

alex_support: I'll start re-provisioning. Asking customer for the list of svc ids and a safe window.

mike_infra: Also logging note: add telemetry to detect tokens where generate passes but batch rerank returns 403 frequently, so we can auto-alert next time.

joanne_cs: Customer replied, thanks and please proceed with re-provision during their maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Keeping thread updated. :white_check_mark:
